messages.subject: Re: Convergence problem - latent state model - measurement invariance - missing values
parts:
> Below you can find my syntax and the output. I would be very grateful
> for any help or ideas.

A few things you could try:

1) provide better starting values for those parameters that are now
completely 'off' Eg.,

y ~~ start(10)*y

will use '10' as the starting value the (residual) variance of y

2) temporarily fix more parameters (to reasonable values) until it
converges; then release them one by one, to find out which one(s) are
the problematic one

3) try to put lower bounds on the variance terms, eg

y ~~ lower(0.001)*y

puts a lower bound of 0.001 for this variance.

4) try the experimental option bounds = TRUE and let me know if it
worked or not.

Yves.
